    • Geopolitical Factors: Prices have been influenced by tensions in the Middle East.
    • Industrial Demand: Strong industrial demand is supporting the current elevated price levels.
    • Outlook: Experts suggest the upward trend may continue, with some forecasting silver could approach or exceed $80 per ounce by the end of 2026.
